notes:
• Smoother scrolling and steadier navigation throughout (rows, show pages, lists)
• Show pages open on the season and episode you're up to; hold OK on a season to mark it watched/unwatched
• Continue Watching, Next Episode and Movies in Progress go straight to sources
• Trakt: like/unlike lists, Add to list… (with New list…), Remove from list
• Next Episode rows update as soon as you finish an episode
• Anime releases with compressed subtitles now play; AV1 files your device can't play are skipped
• TorBox and Offcloud no longer leave played items in your account
• New settings (off/unchanged by default): Service priority, Trailer quality, Second audio language, Subtitles for foreign audio, Anime audio
